== Description ==
Players Committee gallery image of [[Despair (V) (Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds) (PC Gallery Text)|Despair (V)]], present in the Internet Archive capture of 27 November 2007 at 05:33:39 UTC. It shows the earlier remastered gallery wording recorded on that page. The capture establishes that the image was available by that time, not its first publication day.
